item.text: I’ll trace the email confirmation storage and resend flow, record the checkpoint, then update the implementation and run the relevant existing tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Investigating inconsistent email confirmation expiry and resend eligibility in "'`/app`.

Requirements to verify in the implementation:
- Pending state is a strict boolean and optionally matches the requested email.
- Pending confirmation TTL comes from the store'"'s live TTL in milliseconds, or "'`null` when absent.
- Explicit expiration clears the per-user marker and confirmation record.
- Resend eligibility uses milliseconds and is awaited, allowing resend when no pending record exists or when `ttlMs + intervalMs < expiryMs`.

Next: inspect repository guidance, email confirmation code, and relevant existing tests.
EOF
pwd && rg --files -g '"'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' | head -80"

item.text: The current flow gives the per-user marker the resend interval as its lifetime, while the confirmation record has a separate hard-coded one-day expiry. That makes the pending state and resend timing disagree with the configured confirmation expiry. I’m checking the database TTL behavior and call sites now so the fix uses one consistent lifetime.
